text:
kevin: Quick heads-up — planning a soft-launch for rwd-3.1-q4a (eu-west1) as a 2% A/B split starting in ~30m. Goal: cut token cost and tail latency. Need smoke on fidelity and rollout gating before any ramp.

anya: Running our micro-eval suite now (2k samples, mixed prompts). Early notes: latency down ~24% vs rwd-3.0, tokens/sec looks solid. Longform generation ROUGE-L ~ -0.6 pts, hallucination +0.9% (small samples). Uploading sample diffs to the eval bucket.

sam: What are the concrete auto-fallback thresholds we want in the rollout policy? also paste the rollout config pls.

kevin: Proposed quick thresholds (start conservative):
- absolute hallucination delta > 1.5% -> immediate rollback
- MRR/QA accuracy drop > 0.8% absolute -> rollback
- median latency increase > 10% -> divert to baseline
- error-rate spike > 0.5% -> circuit-breaker

Config snippet we'll push (inline):
```
{
  "route": "rwd-chat-prod",
  "variant": "rwd-3.1-q4a",
  "initial_fraction": 0.02,
  "monitoring_windows_min": 15,
  "fallback_conditions": {
    "hallucination_abs_delta": 1.5,
    "mrr_abs_delta": 0.8,
    "latency_pct_increase": 10,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5
  }
}
```

kevin: Note: thresholds are intentionally tight for the first ramp. We'll auto-divert to rwd-3.0 if any condition trips.

anya: For slices: we should split by intent — longform vs Q/A vs code. My micro-eval shows most degradation is in longform (>1.2% hallucination on that slice). Suggest routing 80% of variant traffic to Q/A+short responses, 20% to longform during pilot.

oliver: Watch the KV-cache / prefix-mismatch metric — quant artifacts sometimes nudge tokenization behavior. Add token-prefix-mismatch to the watchlist (threshold 0.3%). Also check batch-size skew on hosts (we saw perf cliffs last month).

ciara-bot: smoke-test completed: 2k requests, 15m window
- perf: median latency -22%
- errors: 0.12%
- hallucination_est (quick heuristic): +0.95%
Link: https://console.redwood/evals/rwd-3.1-q4a/3300001234

kevin: Ok, plan: roll to 2% now, monitor 15m. If all signals within thresholds, auto-ramp to 15% over 30m. If hallucination or MRR breach, immediate rollback and incident ping. I'll push the rollout change and start the split in 10m.

sam: SGTM. I'll wire the alerting dashboard and add a Pager duty rule for the hallucination metric.

anya: Leave a quiet-burn shadow mode for longform for an extra hour (mirror requests but don't count to traffic) — want extra samples.

oliver: added token-prefix-mismatch metric to the dashboard. Also logging note: include model-variant tag and quant-profile in the request trace to correlate.

kevin: thanks — will post the rollout id and commit once live. :rocket:
